title: The Art of Hedging in Science
text:
Researchers who study climate models often use hedging language to signal how confident they are in their findings. Phrases such as 'the data suggest' or 'it is possible that' allow scientists to present results without overstating them.

Critics argue that heavy hedging can obscure a study's main conclusions, leaving readers unsure what the authors actually believe. Others contend that careful qualification is a sign of honesty, since it acknowledges the limits of the evidence.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do hedging phrases allow scientists to do?
options: Prove their findings beyond any doubt
Avoid publishing any data at all

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do critics argue about heavy hedging?
options: It makes studies cheaper to run
It proves that climate models are wrong
It can obscure the study's main conclusions
It should never be used in science

questions.text: The passage suggests that the value of hedging depends mainly on
options: how clearly it reveals the limits of the evidence
how many statistics the text contains
whether the author is a critic or a researcher

questions.text: Which conclusion is best supported by the passage?
options: Hedging should be removed from all academic writing
Scientists rarely disagree about how to qualify claims
Writers must balance qualification with clarity

vocabulary.definition: using qualifying language to show uncertainty
saying that something is stronger than the evidence allows
to make something difficult to see or understand
a word or phrase that limits the strength of a statement

paragraph_translations: Badacze, którzy analizują modele klimatyczne, często używają asekuracyjnych sformułowań, aby pokazać, jak pewni są swoich wyników. Wyrażenia takie jak 'dane sugerują' lub 'możliwe, że' pozwalają naukowcom przedstawić wyniki bez przesadzania.

Krytycy twierdzą, że nadmierna asekuracja może zaciemniać główne wnioski badania, przez co czytelnicy nie wiedzą, w co naprawdę wierzą autorzy. Inni utrzymują, że ostrożne zastrzeżenia są oznaką uczciwości, ponieważ uznają ograniczenia dowodów.
